skill.name: cloudflare-app-bootstrap
skill.description: Get a Cloudflare Workers app to a working local request by connecting its bindings, secrets, and initial data, then verifying real application behavior. Use for app setup or onboarding after the project exists; use frameworks-on-cloudflare or cf-cli to create or configure the project, and wrangler or cf-cli for isolated commands.
skill.summary: Connect bindings, configure secrets, initialize data, and verify a meaningful local request in an existing Cloudflare Workers application.
skill.author: cloudflare

content.user_title: Bootstrap a Cloudflare Workers App Locally
content.value_statement: Existing Cloudflare Workers apps can fail locally when bindings, secrets, or initial data are missing. This skill guides setup and verifies an application request using the project's existing tools.
actual_capabilities: Inspect application roots, lockfiles, scripts, framework versions, and Cloudflare configuration before choosing setup commands.
Map application bindings to existing or local resources while preserving resource identifiers.
Guide D1 initialization with explicit local or remote migration targets and distinguish Durable Objects migration requirements.
Separate build, browser, and runtime configuration while protecting local secret files.
Regenerate binding types and run existing build and type checks.
Exercise a representative application request and document verified behavior, resource targets, and remaining setup.
limitations: Assumes an existing application; delegates initial Cloudflare configuration to related skills.
Requires installed project tools and current documentation to confirm version-specific commands.
Cannot verify behavior that depends on missing credentials or unsupported local services.
Does not deploy unless deployment is part of the requested task.

use_cases.title: Onboard to an existing application
use_cases.description: Connect required bindings and local configuration, then verify a representative request without replacing the existing project.
use_cases.target_user: Developers joining a Cloudflare Workers project

use_cases.title: Initialize a data-backed local workflow
use_cases.description: Apply the minimum local initialization needed for a feature and verify its database access using existing migration tooling.

use_cases.title: Verify repeatable team setup
use_cases.description: Check build and runtime configuration, distinguish local and remote resources, and document tested setup commands and unresolved requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Start an existing app locally
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me run this existing Cloudflare Workers app locally. Preserve its framework and package manager, identify missing configuration, and verify one meaningful request.

prompt_templates.title: Connect bindings and secrets
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this app's bindings and required values. Separate browser, build, and runtime configuration, protect secrets, and report anything missing before verification.

prompt_templates.title: Initialize local application data
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare the minimum local D1 state needed for this feature using existing migrations. Do not modify remote data. Verify the intended response and state change.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a monorepo bootstrap workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Identify the app root and configuration source in this monorepo. Map local and remote bindings, regenerate types, run checks, and document verified setup. Do not deploy.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: validate a complex existing setup

output_examples.input: Describe the expected setup report after verifying a local D1-backed route.
output: Application root, package manager, and existing setup scripts identified.
Required D1 binding mapped to the local database and initialized through existing migrations.
Representative route response and intended database state change checked.
Tested URL, local resource targets, and reproducible setup steps recorded.

output_examples.input: Describe the expected report when an external service credential is missing.
output: Missing runtime secret identified by name without exposing a value.
Local secret file checked for Git exclusion and documented with a safe placeholder.
Remaining setup requirements listed without claiming the application is fully working.

best_practices: Preserve the existing lockfile, configuration source, migration tooling, and resource identifiers.
Confirm account, environment, and local or remote resource targets before creation, migrations, or test writes.
Verify an application request and intended state change, then document tested commands and unresolved requirements.
anti_patterns: Replacing a working application with a starter to fix configuration.
Putting private runtime credentials into public client configuration or committing local secret files.
Treating server startup as proof of working bindings or deploying when only local setup was requested.

faq.question: Does this skill create a new application?
faq.answer: It focuses on existing applications. Missing Cloudflare configuration is delegated to frameworks-on-cloudflare or cf-cli.

faq.question: Does local setup require a Cloudflare login?
faq.answer: Only workflows requiring account access need authentication. Login and deployment are not blanket prerequisites.

faq.question: Can a local Worker access remote services?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill identifies simulated resources and real service calls before exercising writes.

faq.question: How are D1 migrations targeted?
faq.answer: The instructions require explicit local or remote flags. Remote migrations are limited to database changes included in the requested setup.

faq.question: How are secrets handled?
faq.answer: The skill separates browser, build, and runtime values. It protects local secret files, uses placeholders, and distinguishes local secrets from deployed secrets.

faq.question: What counts as successful verification?
faq.answer: A representative route or UI action must produce the expected response and intended state change. Missing credentials and unverified behavior must be reported.
